entry.name: titleFormat
entry.label: Panel text while a window is active (%a = app name, %w = window title, %q = activity)

entry.name: sameFormat
entry.label: Panel text when the app name and window title are the same

entry.name: emptyFormat
entry.label: Panel text when no window is active

entry.name: showIcon
entry.label: Show the window's icon in the panel

entry.name: iconSize
entry.label: Panel icon size in pixels (0 = automatic)

entry.name: maxWidth
entry.label: Maximum panel text width in pixels, longer text is cut with … (0 = no limit)

entry.name: filterByScreen
entry.label: Only show windows on the panel's screen

entry.name: doubleClickMaximize
entry.label: Double-click maximizes or restores the active window

entry.name: panelFontFamily
entry.label: Font family for the panel text (empty = theme font)

entry.name: panelFontSize
entry.label: Font size in points for the panel text (0 = automatic)

entry.name: panelFontWeight
entry.label: Font weight for the panel text (100 = thin ... 900 = black)
